integrity: The proof uses exact shortest-border counting, an absolutely convergent renewal argument, a formal-power-series recursion, and an explicit identification of the A274199 defining reverse-row array with constrained compositions. A standalone verifier checks independent finite enumerations, the array identity, the formal coefficients, and the published numerical constants.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for uniform random words over a fixed alphabet. It gives the limiting width law and mean but not a simpler elementary closed form for the renewal parameter or a new finite-length closed form.
title: Geometric limit law and the A274199 expansion for largest block-palindrome width
